description: This file defines a PHP class 'EmailsViewDetailNonImported' that extends 'ViewDetail' and manages the display of a non-imported email detail view within the SuiteCRM system. It includes methods for initializing view metadata, preparing the display, and rendering the view content.

classes.name: EmailsViewDetailNonImported
classes.description: A PHP class extending ViewDetail that handles the presentation of non-imported email details, including metadata processing and display functions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that sets the view type to 'NonImportedDetail' and calls parent constructor.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Prepares the view before display by loading metadata, initializing the detail view object, populating its bean, and setting up the view.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Triggers processing and outputs the HTML for the email detail view.

methods.name: getFieldsInViewDefinitions
methods.description: Extracts and returns the field names from the view metadata file's 'DetailView' panels.
